meta.title: MoodAura
meta.description: Track Your Moods, Understand Your Mind

ageVerification.title: Emotional Well-being Disclaimer
ageVerification.message: MoodAura is a wellness application intended for users seeking to understand and manage their emotions. If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, please consult a professional.
ageVerification.confirmButton: I Understand and Wish to Proceed

header.tagline: Map Your Moods, Shape Your Journey
header.description: MoodAura helps you track, reflect, and visualize your emotions—empowering you to better understand your inner world through elegant design and meaningful insights.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: Tools designed to help you understand and navigate your emotional landscape

items.title: Mood Tracking
items.description: Log your emotional state, intensity, activities, notes, and location—multiple times per day.

items.title: Visual Mood Timeline
items.description: View your emotions over time using a timeline and matrix inspired by the Circumplex Model of Affect.

items.title: Smart Journaling
items.description: Reflect more deeply with expressive journaling, searchable entries, and personalized insights.

items.title: Analytics & Reports
items.description: Generate insightful PDF reports and visualize trends with interactive charts and summaries.

items.title: Privacy-First Sync
items.description: Your data is stored locally by default, with optional secure cloud sync using Firebase.

discover.title: Take a Look Inside
discover.subtitle: Explore the clean, intuitive interface of MoodAura

features.title: Express with Your Aura
features.description: Add and move the aura to match your current mood. Create a visual representation of how you feel with customizable colors and intensities that reflect your emotional state.

features.title: Complex Emotions
features.description: Add up to 5 moods at once because emotions are rarely simple. Capture the full spectrum of what you're feeling in any given moment.

features.title: Add Context
features.description: Give some context about your mood with notes, activities, and location. Understanding the "why" behind your emotions helps identify patterns and triggers.

features.title: Timeline View
features.description: Visualize your moods through a timeline that shows your emotional journey over days, weeks, or months. Spot trends and patterns at a glance.

features.title: Export Your Journey
features.description: Display or export in PDF a log of your moods. Perfect for sharing with therapists or keeping a personal record of your emotional well-being journey.

features.title: Gentle Reminders
features.description: Be notified everyday to allow MoodAura to ask you how you feel or following a change of your mood. Never forget to check in with yourself.

features.title: Growing Support
features.description: Get some help with a section that will grow over time. Access resources, tips, and guidance for better emotional well-being.

features.title: Bilingual Support
features.description: Use the app in English or French. MoodAura speaks your language to make emotional tracking comfortable and accessible.

download.title: Start Your Journey
download.subtitle: Available now on iOS and Android

restriction.mainDescription: MoodAura is not a medical tool. If you are experiencing severe emotional distress or a mental health emergency, please seek support from a licensed professional.

importantInfo.title: Before You Continue
items: MoodAura is a self-awareness and reflection tool, not a diagnostic service.
By continuing, you acknowledge that MoodAura is not a substitute for professional mental health care.
Your privacy and data are respected, and you can opt out of cloud services at any time.

legalRequirements.title: Ethical Use Reminder
legalRequirements.intro: MoodAura is designed with ethics and safety in mind. Please be aware:
items: Do not use MoodAura to replace professional mental health treatment.
Users are responsible for using the app in a respectful and non-harmful manner.
All content is intended for personal wellness and insight.

restriction.warning: If you need help right now, please close the app and contact a professional support service.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.subtitle: Have questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you.
